declaredHypotheses: PW-600 compact layered nozzle supported by identified B engineering accounts; exact stations, panel/fan counts, accessories, materials and aperture schedule are not measured production data.

Two opposed circular bearing normals use 23.75 degrees as a symmetric reconstruction of 95-degree travel; Rolls-Royce patent supports topology, not those dimensions. Native thrust direction is preserved through conversion and yaw.

Engine installation lowered 0.10 m to fit retained airframe. Engine bay doors use original 90-degree opening around provisional 6 cm outboard hinges, staged over first quarter of conversion. Exact closed mesh remains unchanged.
Two native solids separate upstream core-facing hardware from cooled augmented-flow liner; capacities, cooling and emissivities are provisional. No render-time thermal integrator.
Eight uneven emission lobes and warmer/pink-violet downstream spectra are hypotheses. Gas emission permits dry powered lift while native augmentation remains inhibited.

limits: No browser/server/GPU qualification, device benchmark, performance, energy-saving or acoustic-tier claim.

The source airframe has two existing closed-door/fuselage triangle crossings with maximum 5.676 mm plane straddle. Open-door and engine sweeps pass; general non-watertight containment and coplanar contacts remain unqualified.
One optional scene light affects lit materials; FOSS Earth emissive raster terrain cannot receive its ground patch. No deck impingement, scattering or occlusion model.

Matched reference camera, power, exposure, white balance and day/night GPU appearance remain to be evaluated under a separately requested visual check. Shared GLSL/WGSL image-processing paths have software tests, not GPU shader compilation.
